title: Days Out for Teenagers: Thrills, Escape Rooms & More
description: Days out teenagers actually want: thrill parks, escape rooms, go-karting, zip lines, surfing, skate parks and indoor skydiving, plus ticket tips.
intro: Adrenaline, independence and something worth posting about. Here’s Scout’s pick of days out teenagers rate, plus ways to stop teen tickets costing adult prices.

image.alt: Riders with arms in the air on a roller coaster

blocks.title: Scout’s teen verdict
blocks.text: Give them a say, add a mate, and pick something with a bit of risk (the safe, supervised kind). Escape rooms, karting and zip lines win almost every time.

blocks.title: Adventures for teens
blocks.intro: Filter by place and budget, or let Scout surprise you.

sections.html:
• Many attractions charge adult prices from age 12, 15 or 16. Compare age bands before you book.
  • Students may get discounts with valid ID.
  • Group and birthday packages can work out cheaper per person for escape rooms, karting and laser tag.
  • Rail 2FOR1 offers and annual passes still apply to teens.
Read days out with teenagers, the best thrill rides for teens, teen birthday ideas and a London day out with teens.

faqs.q: What can I do with a bored teenager?
faqs.a: Try an escape room, go-karting, a climbing wall, a zip line, a surf lesson or a thrill park. Letting them choose, and bring a friend, makes a big difference.

faqs.q: At what age do attractions charge adult prices?
faqs.a: It varies. Many charge adult prices from 12, 15 or 16. Check the age bands on the attraction’s ticket page.
